description: The engine offers `canMegaEvo` on a Mega Stone holder and accepts Mega on one slot per choice, never both (golden choice corpus `mega`, `mega-both`). `canMegaEvoX`/`canMegaEvoY` exist only in other mods (`gen7letsgo`, `monkeyspaw`), never in Reg M-C: Charizard X and Y are separate stones. Revisit if a supported format's mod defines them.
